overview_description.description: Tuba is a healthtech platform revolutionizing the way businesses manage and finance employee healthcare in Saudi Arabia and the MENA region. Unlike traditional health insurance, Tuba enables companies to directly fund and control their healthcare spending while offering employees seamless access to medical services. Using AI-powered modules for claims approval, cost prediction, and fraud detection, Tuba simplifies administration, reduces costs, and improves transparency. Businesses gain real-time insights, flexibility in designing benefit plans, and a better overall healthcare experience for their workforce.
